name: The Crystal Tree of Wishes
description: A majestic crystal tree whose branches are crystalline droplets containing tiny glowing wishes; a gentle breeze makes them chime like bells, scattering light across a meadow of soft glowing moss.
prompt: A magnificent Crystal Tree of Wishes: crystalline branches laden with glowing droplet‑like wish orbs, each containing a tiny luminous star, gentle breeze causing them to chime softly and scatter light, surrounding meadow of glowing moss, serene sunrise, photorealistic fantasy.
caption: Touch the Crystal Tree of Wishes and watch your dreams bloom into starlight ✨🌿.
